text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I did it! I won against Flower!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I didn't manage to score 1,000 lengths
over her,
but I think it's quite the
impressive result!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Go on, praise me to
your
heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh, even now?!
choice_data_list: It's hard to call it perfect just yet.
It's still hard to call it perfect.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You might have a point...
choice_data_list: Proof we haven't won by 1000 lengths yet

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Um, I do have a question for you. It just,
well,
popped into my head right about
now.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I don't suppose you're
deceiving me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Did you twitch just now?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yet this is our third year together, and I
still
haven't done any long-distance
training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I support your reasoning on
wanting to
perfect my speed.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However, as of late, I am beginning to
have my
doubts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Training for speed will bring us closer to
her
dream. I trust that she wants that
more than
anyone. But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If I can't convince her now, she could
end up
hurting herself in a race she can't
handle yet.
That's why I'll say...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh... Whoooa?! Does... does that mean...
choice_data_list: Let's schedule races geared toward long distance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Is it finally my time to sweep the Twin
Tenno Sho
and take on the Arima
Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?!
choice_data_list: First up is the GIII Hakodate Sprint Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oh!
choice_data_list: Next up, the GIII CBC Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: What!
choice_data_list: And to finish it off, the GII Centaur Stakes!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't all of those races 1,200 meters?!
None of
them are even close to being
long distance!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I knew it, Trainer, you are deceiving me—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...So? What does that change?
choice_data_list: No, this time we're entering three races.
No, this time we're entering three races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Gasp! You don't mean!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...That's the same distance as the Stayers
Stakes,
the longest race in the Twinkle
Series!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So... if you add a bunch of 1,200-meter
races
together, it becomes a
long-distance race?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And if I place first in all of them... that'll
mean I've
won a 3,600-meter race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely run my heart out! Your
words are so
profound!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I knew I could put my trust in you! I
apologize for
doubting you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I will run all three races! Long distance,
short
distance, I'll Bakushin right through
them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how we decide our next
race will be
the Hakodate Sprint Stakes!
